items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: we formed a little band, Lawrence Murad and so forth.

ctx.x: Yes, okay, you can go ahead with your life.
I'll say, I started playing music in 1919. September, I'll never forget the gate. September the 3rd. The saxophone, just one month. Well, we formed a little band, Lawrence Murad and so forth.
That's to get back to that, that was the E-flat alto.
